📚 Citations, References & Scientific Sources

Authoritative peer-reviewed, statutory, and institutional databases powering this faunal biodiversity atlas.

17 Verified Primary Sources

🔬 Data Synthesis & Validation Methodology

Taxonomic Framework: Classifications adhere strictly to the Zoological Survey of India (ZSI) Faunal Diversity checklists, Catalogue of Life (CoL), and the Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF) taxonomic backbone. All binomial and trinomial nomenclature has been reconciled against accepted authorities.

Spatial & Occurrence Attribution: Occurrence records are derived from multi-tier georeferenced GBIF occurrence datasets, Wildlife Institute of India (WII) protected area surveys, ENVIS State Bio-resource Centers, and regional faunal monographs across all 36 States and Union Territories of the Republic of India.

Habitat Realm Partitioning: Every species has been categorized across the 4 primary realms: Land (Terrestrial biomes, high Himalayas, Thar desert, Western Ghats, peninsular plains), Water (Freshwater rivers, wetlands, torrent streams, mangroves), Sea (Marine waters, coral reefs, continental shelf, oceanic trenches), and Air (Aerial foragers, migratory waterfowl, flying foxes, volant insects).

Photographic Curation: All high-resolution images are authenticated Creative Commons and Open Access nature photography sourced from Wikimedia Commons, iNaturalist Open Data, and GBIF research-grade media.
